purpose: High-value permanent unlocks called out by Ironman skill guides still missing after regional enrichment passes.

policy.region_rule: region_hint is acquisition geography; multi-region use is noted in league_treatment.
policy.rate_rule: Unlock state and effects; no invented XP/h.

activity_additions.name: Diviner's outfit (Guthixian Cache)
unlocks: Diviner's outfit pieces from Guthixian Cache
Up to 6% Divination XP with full set
activity_additions.notes: Primary ironman Divination outfit route. Cache entry is player-driven after depositing memories (DailyScape overhaul).
activity_additions.league_treatment: Memorial/HoM and Cache geography pressure Kandarin for efficient acquisition.

activity_additions.name: All Fired Up beacons (Ring of fire / Flame gloves)

activity_additions.name: Shark / fury shark fishing outfits

activity_additions.name: Infinity ethereal and Runespan utility rewards
